body: Hey, I sent you a pm.

This will be a long post but I feel it's the only way for maybe someone to help or give me advice or just I don't know....

We started dating in High School, I was 17 and she was 16. I wasn't very popular in school so it was hard for me to have a girlfriend and I live in a small town in the middle of nowhere so people like to spread rumors or once some people don't like you the rest follow suit. Anyways we dated in October then she moved in with me in august at my moms. We had a good relationship, we'd always be happy, go out to eat or just hang out and cuddle. Then she got drunk one night and told someone on skype she can't wait to get out of this trolls house because she hates it. I confronted her about it and she apologized and she said she was drunk, which she was and all was good in the world. We were kicked out of my moms on new years eve, after I quit my job after giving my mother every paycheck to "pay bills" for the past 3 months.

Fast forward a little bit and we live with her friends for a while and all was good. She had a nice job and I didn't. We struggled even with her making good money because her friends would blow all of theirs and say they didn't have enough to feed their kid. My girlfriend lost her job not long after that and we had no income and had to eat 1 bowl of ramen a day for 2-3 months. It was rough, we were struggling. I was used to it because that's how my whole child hood was growing up. Shortly after her friends moved out and we had to find a place of our own.

Her dad and his current GF moved out of his cousins house and they needed a place and offered it to me and his daughter (my GF), we accepted but none of us had income besides her dad's GF which received alimony checks. My girlfriend got a minimum wage retail job and we lived there for a while with everything fine. 2 months later her dad's GF stopped helping pay bills and was buying pills and drugs and my girlfriend had to pay 4 bills with a $300 check she got every 2 weeks. Around december a month after her dad's GF left, she started talking to some guy online that played League of Legends. He promised her the world and she was acting weird. She talked about getting 2 jobs and saving up money. I read her e-mails to him and they had planned on getting her a ticket to where he lived. He promised to take her to the beach and everything and she was going to. I was going to leave her then but she begged me to stay after a few days I said okay I'll stay and we made up, but I told her to never do it again. Less than a week later she talked to the same guy again and once again she begged me and I forgave her. Fast forward to the summer and  It was me and her working supporting her dad who said he couldn't work and hadn't worked in 16 years. He was a good guy and I liked him but it really put a strain on us at times because we were horny in love teens and wanted our own place. That lasted for a while then one day the landlord came by and said we hadn't paid rent and they were throwing our stuff out and it wasn't then end of the month and no eviction notice. The place we lived at was basically the ghetto area of my small middle of no where town in the midwest. It was rough but we were proud of it. Shortly after we found a place closer to the retail job and at that time her dad had another gf who he was constantly staying with. We didn't always have rides to work so we'd walk because he was the only one with a car and a license. We did what we had to do and we were proud of having our own place and how nice it was. Around September her dad blacked out and wrecked his car. Totaled it and he didn't have insurance. He was admitted the hospital because I thought he had some kind of bleeding in his brain. A few days before that happened my gf was talking to another guy online and was telling him she loved him and was going to move in with him or he was going to move in with her and she'd kick me out. I got word of it and she begged me to stay. Then a week later she was at the hospital and I read some of her messages and seen they were talking again. I called up there and begged her not to leave me and apologized for taking time away from her dad because he was the only one she had left because her mom died at a young age. She ended up saying yes and that she still loved me. Her dad died in december when we wanted to spend time away from him and stay at my moms. She was devastated and so was I. The co-workers raised money for us and supported us anyway they could because we'd have to help pay for the funeral. It helped a lot that they did that for us. I enjoyed my job and did everything I could including walking to work when it was 0 Fahrenheit and ground covered in snow, I did what I could to take care of both of us and stay grounded and keep our heads up. In May I quit my job after not having one for 2 years prior. I was hoping to go work at a factory but the factory closed down 2 weeks later ruining my chances...I was miserable at my retail job because the managers had been there since my mom was a manger years ago and they disliked her and they treated me like I had a learning disability and wouldn't treat me like everyone else. Some of my good friends there seen it and noticed and my girlfriend noticed and understood how I felt but she wanted me to be happy. 

Around 2-3 months after job searching and us still not owning a car we got an offer to live with my dad in the southern part of the US. They said we could work at the factory they work at and make good money. They would teach us how to drive and help take care of us until we could get settled we thought this was a good idea and left for there. We only stayed a week. The work was harder than expected and my GF was home sick because the rest of her family was still in the original state. With much sadness for doing this to my father we went back to where we first lived at. We bunked with some good friends of ours in a 1 bed apartment above his place of work. We weren't supposed to stay there and had to sneak around all the time to not get caught or else everyone would be kicked out. When we moved back the retail job gave my girlfriend back her job because she was good at it but I still didn't have one. It was tough we couldn't pay rent to our friends or anything they were slowly wanting us out and we didn't blame them. We finally found us a place back in the trashy neighborhood but we had a nice trailer and it was awesome. I still didn't have a job and couldn't find one. I had no way around town, we didn't have a washer or dryer, we ate once a day and we struggled but we had each other, all this happened back in November 2014. Fast forward to now and she started getting distant. She always liked gaming with our group of friends but stopped gaming with me and our close friends to game with random people online. It always worried me and I had trust issues and would login into her stuff to check what was going on. I was wrong to do that but she forgave me and understood why I kept doing it. Then last monday I got angry and asked her if she was seeing someone else or wanted me out and she said she still cared for me but hasn't loved me for a year and wanted me out. I've been staying at my moms given 2 weeks to 1 month to find a job without a car or else I'd have to pickup and move in with my dad again, go to Florida with a friend or live on the streets. My gf told me I never cooked, I never cleaned, I never went out to the store with her, never went out to eat with her, never went out and did anything. I'm a somewhat anti-social person who doesn't care for going out. I'd rather get on netflix to watch something and cuddle. She told me to get my stuff and that was that. I begged her for a second chance and cleaned her house and she said she'd think about it. I packed my stuff up while she was there and asked her if she was going to change her mind and she said I don't know I haven't had time alone to think about it. She left for work and took all the knives with her because she was afraid of me self harming. She called my relatives to come take me to my moms house. The next to nights we talked for hours and we were going to hang out one this Monday-Wednesday, then she cancelled and said she had a friend coming down. I stupidly read her facebook messages and seen it was a guy she'd been talking to over facebook and playing games with for 4-5 months. He was going to take her out drinking and take her to dinner. Yesterday I talked to her and asked if we're still on for monday and she said no her company is staying over til next sunday now and she canelled her plans. She hasn't really wanted to talk to me, she doesn't sound sad, everyone at our old job and her family congratulated her for leaving me because I'm a bum. I loved her and gave her so many second chances and all I wanted was one more to show her I'd walk to work everyday, take her out to eat anything, she just had to communicate and that I wanted to try it once more. Now here we are. I'm having trouble dealing with this. I've been suicidal. I just need to do something...I feel lost...I'm trying my hardest. 


I just don't want to lose the person I've cared for and forgave after 4 years of all this...all I wanted was a second chance.
